name: Action
summary: When a user clicks a link or bookmark in a PDF, an action occurs, moving the reader to a new location.

name: AddPageFlags
summary: Flags that control how annotations are handled when adding a page to a Content object.

name: AFRelationship
summary: Represents the relationship between the component of the PDF document that refers to this attachment and the file denoted by the attachment

name: Annotation
summary: Associates an object with its location on a page of a PDF document.

name: AnnotationFlags
summary: Bitfield flags that control the display and behavior of annotations.

name: AxialShadingPattern
summary: A color blend that varies along an axis.

name: BlendMode
summary: The blend mode used for painting objects.

name: Bookmark
summary: A bookmark on a page of a PDF document.

name: BookmarkFlags
summary: Flags describing the visual style of a bookmark's title text.

name: CalGrayColorSpace
summary: A calibrated gray color space.

name: CalRGBColorSpace
summary: A calibrated RGB color space.

name: CancelProc
summary: A callback function used to abort an operation.

name: CircleAnnotation
summary: A circle annotation is an annotation surrounded by a curved and possibly elliptical border.

name: Clip
summary: A clipping path is used to mark an area within a page to be highlighted or removed.

name: ClosePath
summary: An operator that completes a vector shape, drawing a line from the first point to the last point.

name: Collection
summary: Allows for manipulation of PDF collections, or portfolios.

name: CollectionSchema
summary: Provides for adding/removing/retrieving schema fields in a collection.

name: CollectionSchemaField
summary: Allows for the creation of collection schema field objects.

name: CollectionSortItem
summary: Stores data about fields that viewers use for sorting collection items.

name: CollectionSplitType
summary: Specifies the split orientation for a PDF collection (portfolio) view.

name: CollectionViewType
summary: Specifies the type of navigator view used to display a PDF collection (portfolio).

name: Color
summary: A color specified by values appropriate for its color space.

name: ColorConvertActions
summary: Class that defines color conversion actions for an object described by certain attributes.

name: ColorConvertParams
summary: Holds parameters to be passed to a color convert method. This includes the actions to take in case of a match. Each object is compared against the selection criteria for each of the actions, in order, until a matching action is found.

name: ColorSpace
summary: Base class for all color spaces.

name: ColorValueConverter
summary: This class contains methods used to convert sets of values from one Colorspace to another.

name: CompressImageType
summary: Enumerator to allow the selection of image type to Set the values for resampling and recompression.

name: CompressionCode
summary: Compression values for generating graphics files from PDF pages. A compression value must be provided for JPG or GIF images.

name: CompressionType
summary: Enumerator used to select type of compression used when images are recompressed.

name: CompressQuality
summary: Establish the compression quality to be used in compression schemas that allow variable quality. (JPEG, JPEG2000, JBIG2). Unset should be selected for compression schemes that are inherently lossless (Flate, CCITTG3, or CCITTG4). JBIG2 may select any value. JPEG and JPEG2000 can select any value between Minimum and Maximum, but should not select Unset or Lossless.

name: Container
summary: A container class represents a group of elements on a page in a PDF file.

name: Content
summary: Class that represents the collection of elements on a PDF page.

name: CredentialDataFmt
summary: Enumeration to specify credential encoding format as either Non-PFX (PEM/DER) or PFX (PKCS#12).

name: CredentialStorageFmt
summary: Enumeration to specify credential is required to be retrieved from disk (OnDisk) or is cached in memory (InMemory).

name: CurveTo
summary: The curveto operator is used to draw a Bezier curve.

name: CurveToV
summary: A curveto operator where the first control point matches the beginning.

name: CurveToY
summary: A curveto operator where the second control point matches the end point.

name: DeviceNColorSpace
summary: Represents a color space with an arbitrary number of color components.

name: DigestCategory
summary: Enumeration to specify cryptographic hash functions that generate variable-length message digests required for digital signature creation.

name: DisplayTraits
summary: Enumeration to specify fields to display as part of signature appearance.

name: DocTextFinder
summary: A class used to extract words from a document using a regular expression.

name: DocTextFinderConfig
summary: A document text finder configuration that customizes the way the extracted text is processed. In the default configuration, all options are false. Structure representing configuration options for DocTextFinder.

name: DocTextFinderMatch
summary: A phrase in the document that matched the supplied regular expression along with its associated quad bounding box(es).

name: DocTextFinderQuadInfo
summary: A bounding box quad of a character in a PDF file that was part of a string that matched a given regular expression.

name: Document
summary: The underlying PDF representation of a document.

name: DrawParams
summary: Settings for rendering PDF pages as images.

name: Duplex
summary: Duplex values.

name: Element
summary: The base class for elements of the content of a page.

name: EncodingInfo
summary: Represents a font's encoding data.

name: ExponentialFunction
summary: An interpolation between two output values as input values vary across a domain.

name: ExtendedGraphicState
summary: The extended graphic state, to supplement original graphic state.

name: FarEastFont
summary: CJK font related option for PostScript printing.

name: FileAttachment
summary: A file attachment. Any file can be attached to the PDF document.

name: FileSpecification
summary: Refers to the location of a PDF file within a file system.

name: FlattenerColorCompression
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Color images.

name: FlattenerGrayCompression
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Grayscale images.

name: FlattenerMonoCompression
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Monochrome images.

name: FlattenerQualitySetting
summary: Enumeration for setting the Quality setting for the JPEG or JPEG2000 images.

name: FlattenTransparencyParams
summary: Represents control parameters for flattening transparencies within a PDF file.

name: Font
summary: Represents a font. Defines the typeface, size, style (bold, italic), Unicode values, and other details.

name: FontCreateFlags
summary: Flags for creating fonts. If you want to subset a font, set both the Embedded and Subset flags

name: FontFlags
summary: Bit masks describing font characteristics from the font descriptor.

name: FontRescanFlags
summary: Flags controlling which font directories to rescan after initialization.

name: Form
summary: Represents a PDF form XObject.

name: FormsExtensionVersionRec
summary: Structure to hold the version number retrieved by GetFormsExtensionVersion()

name: FreeTextAnnotation
summary: The free text annotation allows a user to place text directly on a PDF page.

name: Function
summary: A function is a process.

name: GoToAction
summary: A go-to action can be executed in a PDF document.

name: GraphicState
summary: The graphic state is an internal data structure in a PDF file.

name: Group
summary: A set of elements to be used within a PDF document.

name: HighlightAnnotation
summary: Allows the user to highlight text appearing on a PDF page.

name: HighlightStyle
summary: Specifies the visual effect used when a link annotation is activated (clicked).

name: ICCBasedColorSpace
summary: Works with the ICC color space.

name: Image
summary: An image resource can either be an image XObject or inline image found in a page's content stream.

name: ImageCollection
summary: An image collection can hold multiple images, created from an image file.

name: ImageData
summary: A class representing the decompressed Image Data.

name: ImageSaveParams
summary: Class that defines parameters for saving an image to a graphics file.

name: Inclusion
summary: Specifies how to include a resource in a file.

name: IndexedColorSpace
summary: Indexed color spaces are used to reduce the amount of memory used for processing images.

name: Ink
summary: The ink object represents the color in the color space, CYMK or RGB.

name: InkAnnotation
summary: A type of annotation allowing a user to edit a PDF document.

name: InkTypes
summary: Specifies the ink type used for trapping purposes.

name: LabColorSpace
summary: A Lab color space is a CIE-based ABC color space with two transformation stages.

name: Language
summary: Languages which may be selected. To find if a language is available, call IsLanguageAvailable() on the OCREngine.

name: LanguageSetting
summary: Specify a language, along with any metadata about that language.

name: LaunchAction
summary: A launch action launches an application or opens or prints a document.

name: Library
summary: Used to create a new instance of a library object or change properties.

name: LibraryFlags
summary: Flags for initializing the library. Unless you require fine-grain control of the intialization process of the library there is no need to use LibraryFlags or you can specify the value of NoFlags.

name: LineAnnotation
summary: The line annotation displays a single straight line on a PDF page.

name: LineCap
summary: The line cap style specifies the shape to be used at the ends of open subpaths (and dashes, if any) when they are stroked.

name: LineJoin
summary: The line join style specifies the shape to be used at the corners of paths that are stroked. Join styles are significant only at points where consecutive segments of a path connect at an angle; segments that meet or intersect fortuitously receive no special treatment.

name: LineTo
summary: A lineto operator, which draws a straight line.

name: LinkAnnotation
summary: A link annotation, which features an embedded hyperlink.

name: LogOutputFlags
summary: Flags that control where DLE log output is written.

name: LogParams
summary: Defines the parameters for writing error messages to a log file.

name: Matrix
summary: A transformation matrix in a PDF file is specified by six numbers.

name: MissingFontStrategy
summary: The behavior to use if a suitable Font can't be found to represent the recognized Text.

name: MoveTo
summary: An operator that creates a path by moving to a new current position.

name: NamedColorSpace
summary: Class used to define the color space in use.

name: NamedFunction
summary: Defines a function currently in use.

name: NameTree
summary: The name tree is a common data structure in PDF files.

name: NumberStyle
summary: Specifies the numbering style for page labels in a document.

name: NumberTree
summary: The number tree is a common data structure in PDF files.

name: ObjectCompressionType
summary: Enumerator to allow the selection of object compression type to Set the values for object compression type.

name: OCREngine
summary: Represents an OCR Engine and its configuration.

name: OCRParams
summary: Parameters for configuring the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) engine.

name: OptimizerOption
summary: Select the optimization option to be set or obtained.

name: OptionalContentConfig
summary: A structure used to store data related to layers in a PDF.

name: OptionalContentContext
summary: Defines the context for optional content in a PDF.

name: OptionalContentDrawingPolicy
summary: The policy for drawing optional content within the document.

name: OptionalContentGroup
summary: A dictionary used to manage graphics images in a PDF.

name: OptionalContentMembershipDict
summary: Attaches content to one or more optional content groups.

name: OptionalContentOrderArray
summary: Array node class for items in the OptionalContentConfig Order array.

name: OptionalContentOrderLeaf
summary: Leaf node class for items in the OptionalContentConfig Order array.

name: OptionalContentOrderNode
summary: Base class for items in the OptionalContentConfig Order array.

name: OutputType
summary: Specifies what kind of file to emit.

name: OverprintMode
summary: A code specifying whether a color component value of 0 in a DeviceCMYK color space should erase that component or leave it unchanged when overprinting.

name: Page
summary: Represents a page within a PDF file.

name: PageImageParams
summary: Used to manage converting a PDF page to an image.

name: PageLabel
summary: Describes numbering labels for a range of pages.

name: PageMarkFlags
summary: Bit flags indicating which page marks are emitted for color separations.

name: PageMode
summary: An enumerated data type used to describe the page view mode of a Document.

name: PageRange
summary: Specifies a range of pages in a document (page numbers begin with 0).

name: PageSegmentationMode
summary: Specify how the OCR engine will view the page, and how it detects text segments.

name: PageSpec
summary: Page range specifications

name: PageTilingMode
summary: PageTilingMode

name: PaperSource
summary: Defines a set of paper trays in a printer that can be used to select the paper source when printing.

name: Path
summary: A path in a PDF file defines shapes.

name: PathOperators
summary: Enumerated data type for path segment operators in PDEPath elements.

name: PathPaintOpFlags
summary: Flags indicating the different paint operations for a Path.

name: Pattern
summary: A pattern is used to fill an area to be painted.

name: PDETextFlags
summary: Flags that control how text is accessed or measured within a PDEText object.

name: PDFAConvertParams
summary: Parameters for converting a document to PDF/A compliance.

name: PDFAConvertResult
summary: Contains a PDF document if the conversion is successful; returns null if the conversion fails.

name: PDFAConvertType
summary: Specifies the PDF/A conformance level and color space for conversion.

name: PDFArray
summary: Represents an array of data elements within a PDF document.

name: PDFBoolean
summary: Represents a boolean data element within a PDF document.

name: PDFDict
summary: Represents an associative collection of data elements within a PDF document.

name: PDFInteger
summary: Represents an integer data element within a PDF document.

name: PDFlattenerColorCompSet
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Color images.

name: PDFlattenerGrayscaleCompSet
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Grayscale images.

name: PDFlattenerMonochromeCompSet
summary: Enumeration for setting the compression scheme for the Flattened Monochrome images.

name: PDFlattenerQualitySetting
summary: Enumeration for setting the Quality setting for the JPEG or JPEG2000 images.

name: PDFName
summary: Represents a name data element within a PDF document.

name: PDFObject
summary: Represents the underlying simple data element of an object in a PDF document.

name: PDFObjectComparison
summary: Comparisons between two PDFObjects.

name: PDFObjectEnumProc
summary: Represents callback function for Document.EnumIndirectPDFObjects & PDFObject.Enum.

name: PDFOptimizationCompressQuality
summary: Specifies the quality level for lossy image compression during PDF optimization.

name: PDFOptimizer
summary: Implementation of the PDF Optimizer function.

name: PDFOptimizerCompressImageType
summary: Specifies the category of images to target during PDF optimization compression.

name: PDFOptimizerCompressionType
summary: Specifies the compression algorithm to use when recompressing images during PDF optimization.

name: PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionType
summary: Specifies the object-level stream compression strategy during PDF optimization.

name: PDFProcessorPDFAConversionOption
summary: Specifies which PDF/A standard and color space to use when converting a document to PDF/A.

name: PDFProcessorPDFXConversionOption
summary: Specifies which PDF/X standard to use when converting a document to PDF/X.

name: PDFReal
summary: Represents a floating point data element within a PDF document.

name: PDFStream
summary: Represents a stream of data within a PDF document.

name: PDFString
summary: Represents an array of unsigned bytes within a PDF document.

name: PDFXConvertParams
summary: Parameters for converting a document to PDF/X compliance.

name: PDFXConvertResult
summary: Contains a PDF document if the conversion is successful; returns null if the conversion fails.

name: PDFXConvertType
summary: Specifies the PDF/X standard version to convert a document to.

name: Performance
summary: Specify the performance of the OCR engine in an abstract way. In Tesseract, for instance, this changes the OCREngineMode.

name: Point
summary: Represents a discrete point or space in a PDF.

name: PolygonAnnotation
summary: A polygon is a closed plane figure bounded by a finite number of line segments.

name: PolyLineAnnotation
summary: A finite number of line segments in a PDF added as an annotation.

name: PostScript
summary: An XObject stream with the subtype PostScript.

name: PostScriptCalculatorFunction
summary: A function represented as a stream containing code written in a small subset of the PostScript language.

name: PrintCancelProc
summary: Print cancellation callback function, a class used to cancel print operations.

name: PrintParams
summary: Print settings, primarily used for PostScript printers or output.

name: PrintProgressProc
summary: Print progress callback function, a class used to notify print client of the progress during print operations.

name: PrintUserParams
summary: A structure used to set parameters for print jobs.

name: PrintWhat
summary: What portions of the document to print

name: PrintWhatAnnotFlags
summary: Which annotations to print

name: ProgressMonitor
summary: Represents the progress of an operation.

name: QRColor
summary: Used to control how the QR color is created.

name: QREncodeParams
summary: Used to control how the QR code is created.

name: QRErrorCorrectionLevel
summary: The Error Correction Level of the QR Code

name: Quad
summary: Represents a quadrilateral in a program.

name: Rect
summary: A rect holds four coordinates for a rectangle.

name: RectSegment
summary: A rectangle path operator.

name: Redaction
summary: Associates an object with its location on a page of a PDF document.

name: RemoteDestination
summary: A view of a page contained in a separate document.

name: RemoteGoToAction
summary: A remote go-to action is an action that includes a RemoteDestination object.

name: RenderProgressProc
summary: Render progress callback function, a class used to notify client of the progress during rendering operations.

name: RenderProgressStage
summary: Identifies the current stage of a rendering or flattening operation.

name: ReportProc
summary: Represents the error reporting callback function.

name: ReportType
summary: Type codes used for error reporting.

name: RolledBackDocument
summary: A class representing a Rolled back instance of a PDF document that was previously saved Incrementally.

name: SchemaFieldSubtype
summary: The data type of a collection schema field.

name: Segment
summary: Represents a segment, or a single line, within a path.

name: SeparationColorSpace
summary: Defines the use of additional named colorants in a PDF document.

name: SeparationParams
summary: Holds parameters for making color separations. Used with PostScript.

name: SeparationPlate
summary: Represents a plate for making print separations. Used with PostScript.

name: SeparationPreviewOptions
summary: Specifies how a colorant is handled during a separation preview.

name: Shading
summary: Represents a region shaded with color, as defined by a shading dictionary.

name: ShadingPattern
summary: A shading pattern consists of a smoothly varying gradient between two colors.

name: SignatureFieldID
summary: Digital signature field options

name: SignatureType
summary: Enumeration to specify fields to display as part of signature appearance.

name: SignDoc
summary: Implementation of the PDF SignDoc function.

name: SquareAnnotation
summary: The square annotation allows a user to display a rectangle on a PDF page.

name: StructElement
summary: Internal wrapper for a single node in the PDF logical structure tree.

name: StructTreeRoot
summary: Internal wrapper for the root of a PDF logical structure tree.

name: Style
summary: Provides access to data about fonts, font sizes, and colors used in a word.

name: StyleTransition
summary: Represents a style change in a word.

name: TempStoreType
summary: Enumeration for selecting the temporary storage type used by the library.

name: Text
summary: A container that represents a series of text elements and characters.

name: TextFlags
summary: Flags that control how text operations address text within a Text object.

name: TextMarkupAnnotation
summary: Annotations that appears as highlighted content when added to a PDF file.

name: TextRenderMode
summary: Text rendering mode determines whether text shown will have glyph outlines stroked, filled, used as a clipping path boundary, or feature some combination of those three values.

name: TextRun
summary: Represents one or more contiguous characters in a text object.

name: TextState
summary: The text state includes parameters that affect text.

name: TIFFByteOrder
summary: TIFF Byte Order values describing the byte order used within a file.

name: UnderlineAnnotation
summary: A type of text markup annotation, for underlining text.

name: URIAction
summary: A text string, typically a hyperlink.

name: VerticalAlignment
summary: Specification of vertical alignment options.

name: ViewDestination
summary: Represents a particular view of a page in a document.

name: WatermarkDrawOption
summary: Specifies how a watermark should be drawn in a PDF document.

name: WatermarkParams
summary: Watermark settings control the appearance of a watermark in a PDF.

name: WatermarkTextParams
summary: Watermark settings to control the appearance of text in a text-based watermark.

name: WebConvertInfo
summary: Result metadata for a completed web-to-PDF conversion: page count, conversion time, document title, and resolved source URL. `Populate()` reads the plugin's last-conversion record on supported platforms and is a no-op (returning false) on the stub path; the page count is then overridden by the curator bridge with the authoritative count from the opened PDF.

name: WebToPDFConvertParams
summary: Parameters that control web/HTML-to-PDF conversion. Configure the target page geometry, viewport, image handling, and behavior on this object, then pass it to a web-to-PDF conversion call. The enum-valued settings (viewport preset, page size, page orientation, image compression, and downsampling resolution) take named values rather than raw integers. Safe to construct and configure on any platform; conversion itself runs only where the WebToPDF plugin is supported.

name: Word
summary: A word in a PDF file.

name: WordAttributeFlags
summary: Flags returned by Word.GetAttributes.

name: WordFinder
summary: A class used to extract words from a document.

name: WordFinderConfig
summary: A word finder configuration that customizes the way the extraction is performed. In the default configuration, all options are false.

name: WordFinderVersion
summary: This refers to versions of the WordFinder algorithm. WordFinder extracts words from a PDF file and enumerates the words on a single page or on all of the pages in the document.

name: WordProc
summary: Callback function class for EnumWords.

name: WritingMode
summary: The direction of writing

name: XPSConvertParams
summary: Class that works with XPS conversion parameters.
